questions.stem_text: Frank (1967) made the claim that 'underdeveloped' societies were:

options.A: insufficiently involved in the international capitalist economy
options.B: reluctant to surrender their traditional ways of life
options.C: economically dependent on the wealthy countries that exploited them
options.D: the 'metropoles' to which 'satellite' countries were attached

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - economically dependent on the wealthy countries that exploited them

questions.stem_text: Pilcher (1999) identified soap operas as a 'feminine genre' of media because:

options.A: most of the characters in soap operas are women
options.B: they represent images of women as both domesticated and independent
options.C: they alienate women and appeal to an audience of men
options.D: female television producers are most likely to work in this area

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - they represent images of women as both domesticated and independent

questions.stem_text:
Sreberny-Mohammadi (1996) argues that national cultures can resist American cultural
domination of the media by:

options.A: domesticating its content, including more 'home-produced' programmes
options.B: controlling the distribution of imported products by banning satellite dishes
options.C: creating 'reverse flows' of their own programmes back to imperial societies

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - all of the above

questions.stem_text: The market model of state welfare is based on the principle of:

options.A: individuals buying welfare privately, with some means-tested benefits
options.B: regular benefit payments to men as earners of the 'family wage'
options.C: a universalist system of welfare for all, regardless of income
options.D: decommodifying social welfare through state provision

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - individuals buying welfare privately, with some means-tested benefits
